RAGify Demo Onboarding Guide (Test Fixture)
Version: 1.0
Last Updated: 2025-12-31

SECTION: ARRIVAL & CHECK-IN
- You should arrive at the office by 8:00 AM.
- Check in at the main reception on the 3rd floor.
- If you arrive after 8:15 AM, message your manager in Slack.

SECTION: ORIENTATION
- Orientation starts at 9:00 AM in Conference Room Cedar (3rd floor).
- Bring a government-issued ID for badge pickup.

SECTION: TEAM LUNCH
- Team lunch is at 12:00 PM in the kitchen area (2nd floor).

SECTION: BADGE
- Your employee badge will be issued on Day 1 at reception.
- Badge pickup window: 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

SECTION: DOCUMENTS TO BRING
- Bring your ID and your signed offer letter.
- Optional: direct deposit form.

NOTE (Edge-case text for chunking):
The following paragraph is intentionally long to test chunk boundaries and overlap behavior.
